sections.heading: Registration, title, insurance and inspection
sections.markdown:
# Registration, title, insurance and inspection

FACT_ID: sec17-F01 | anchor: A01
Louisiana requires a motor vehicle to have a title and registration. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F02 | anchor: A01
Title, registration and plate applications can be handled through a motor vehicle office or licensed public tag agent. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F03 | anchor: A01
A public tag agent may charge additional service fees. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F04 | anchor: A01
A Louisiana new-vehicle dealer supplies an assigned certificate of origin and a notarized invoice. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F05 | anchor: A01
The guide says dealers commonly collect taxes and fees and send the documents for the buyer’s title and plate. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F06 | anchor: A01
A temporary dealer plate must be visible from behind the vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F07 | anchor: A01
For a used-vehicle purchase, the previous owner or dealer must properly assign the certificate of title to the buyer. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F08 | anchor: A01
The seller must deliver the properly assigned title when the vehicle is sold or delivered. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F09 | anchor: A01
If a title lists a lien, check for release by an authorized representative of the lienholder. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F10 | anchor: A01
The guide’s title application list includes the assigned notarized title and a liability-insurance declaration. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F11 | anchor: A01
A separate bill of sale is unnecessary under the guide when the selling price is entered in the title’s designated space. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F12 | anchor: A01
A mortgage document is required with the title application when applicable. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F13 | anchor: A01
Keep the registration certificate inside the vehicle and show it when law enforcement requests it. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F14 | anchor: A01
A duplicate registration can be obtained through a motor vehicle office or public tag agent if the original is lost. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0140]

FACT_ID: sec17-F15 | anchor: A02
A new Louisiana resident must transfer title and registration for vehicles brought into the state during the move. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-F16 | anchor: A02
A new resident’s registration documents include the out-of-state title and registration and evidence of insurance. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-F17 | anchor: A02
When an out-of-state lienholder holds the title, the guide calls for a photocopy of it. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-F18 | anchor: A02
Bring proof of taxes paid in the previous state when transferring a vehicle to Louisiana. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]
